result.summary: The page appears largely functional with no critical broken elements. However, there are minor layout and content truncation issues visible.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated in the 'Fastest near you' section.
issues.suggestion: Consider using a smaller font size, truncating with an ellipsis more gracefully, or allowing the text to wrap to ensure the full name is visible or clearly indicated as truncated.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar icons and labels might be too close to the screen edge on some devices, potentially causing accidental taps or being obscured by system gestures.
issues.suggestion: Ensure adequate padding around the bottom navigation bar to prevent overlap with system UI elements.
